snippet.title: Minsgon Simulator - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the release date trailer for Minsgon Simulator, a collectathon simulation game developed by 
Vokcen. Hatch mysterious eggs and discover over 150 Minsgon species!  Tame, raise, and train wild creatures to help them evolve, then showcase and sell them in your shop and garden. Unlock new skills and rise to fame in the world of Minsgon! Minsgon Simulator is launching on August 21 for PC (Steam).
